promises.quote: The Department has published a Strategic Framework for Road Safety, which sets out general safety measures.
promises.summary: Publishes a Strategic Framework for Road Safety

concerns.quote: I am concerned that the regulations that have been introduced requiring lorries to have forward facing mirrors are not retrospective, hence there are a large number of lorries on the road which do not have this facility

promises.quote: The Department is also working with the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT), Transport for London (TfL) and other stakeholders on HGV safety. This activity includes the development and promotion of safer lorry designs.
promises.summary: Develop safer lorry designs with stakeholders

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that older large goods vehicles lack required front‑facing mirrors, creating a blind spot for pedestrians and cyclists. They call for making the mirror requirement retrospective to prevent collisions.
